title: Anti-scrambling and euclidean folds from observer correlators in de Sitter space
summary: The de Sitter horizon behaves in a qualitatively different way from a black hole horizon, which poses a challenge to any attempt to develop a fundamental quantum description of de Sitter space. In this paper we gather some ``data'' on this problem using gravitational calculations, seeing that they lead to an ``anti-scrambling'' phenomenon that is contrary to the behavior of standard many-body quantum systems.
